what: Pinned source for the Amarsi-2020 GALAH non-LTE DEPARTURE-COEFFICIENT (b-factor) grids. These are b per atmospheric depth per atomic level over a MARCS grid -- NOT pre-computed abundance deltas. They require NLTE SYNTHESIS (Turbospectrum bsyn NLTE) to convert to line-by-line abundance corrections (that conversion is what pipeline/nlte_bfactor_synth.py does).

paper.cite: Amarsi, A. M., Lind, K., Osorio, Y., et al. 2020, A&A 642, A62, 'The GALAH Survey: non-LTE departure coefficients for large spectroscopic surveys'

grid_axes: 3756 1D MARCS models: 3000 <= Teff/K <= 8000, -0.5 <= logg <= 5.5, -5 <= [Fe/H] <= 1 (plus the abundance A(X) and depth axes for the departure coefficients)

data_repository.host: Zenodo (deposit 'Grid/NLTE', author Amarsi, Anish Mayur, Uppsala University)
data_repository.latest_version_seen: v6, 2025-03-21, record https://zenodo.org/records/15062813 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15062813) -- NOTE v6 hosts Cu/H/Ti only.
data_repository.needed_version: the GALAH-2020 release version of this same Zenodo concept that contains Na / Al / K (the 13-element A&A 642 A62 set). Pick the version whose file list includes nlte_Na_*, nlte_Al_*, nlte_K_*.

file_format.atmos_{El}.txt: list of MARCS atmospheres / grid nodes
file_format.label_{El}.txt: grid axis labels (Teff/logg/[Fe/H]/A(X) nodes; level labels)
file_format.nlte_{El}_{tag}.txt: ASCII departure coefficients b(level, depth) over the grid (large, up to several GB)
file_format.nlte_{El}_{tag}_pysme.grd / _idlsme.grd: binary departure grids for PySME / IDL-SME

fetch_instructions_for_ryan: Grab the Na, Al, and K departure grids (atmos_{El}.txt + label_{El}.txt + nlte_{El}_*.txt, and optionally the *_pysme.grd) from the Na/Al/K-bearing version of the Zenodo 'Grid/NLTE' deposit, and drop them into data/nlte_grids/amarsi2020_galah/. Na is needed FIRST -- it is the validate-the-machinery cross-check (reproduce the INSPECT Na delta -0.107 through the synthesis path before trusting Al/K).
engine_note: The local Turbospectrum bsyn_lu binary HAS the NLTE path compiled in (read_departure.f / read_nlteinfofile.f; control keys NLTEINFOFILE, MODELATOMFILE, DEPARTUREFILE; 'no departure file -> coefficients = 1.0'). iSpec's Python wrapper does NOT expose it, so pipeline/nlte_bfactor_synth.py drives bsyn_lu directly.
